scientific_integrity: Complete analytic proof; exact-rational finite corroboration and numerical unrestricted LP spotchecks; no independent mathematical audit or formal certification.
scientific_limitations: Finite cyclic two-layer metrics with three equilateral points in each layer; nonzero real Banach targets and linear Lipschitz-seminorm operators. Does not cover arbitrary noncyclic extensions, higher orbits, complex targets, nonlinear maps, or a continuum-wide extension. Classical Pompeiu lemma is a known input.
title: No simultaneous-extension penalty for cyclic triples over an equilateral source
